name: The Westside Connection
caption: A three-wrestler stable named for, and sharing the entrance music of, the real hip-hop group Westside Connection, whose members won the inaugural PCW Tag Team Championship in a four-team ladder match at "One Night in Hollywood," 16 August 1998.
notes: The fed's own title ledger credits the win to "The Westside Connection" without naming which two of its three members wrestled; all three are listed as members on that basis.

name: The Stone Crushers
caption: A tag team billed to challenge for the PCW Tag Team Championship on the fed's own schedule page; no member names survive.

tenures.note: Billed to challenge the Westside Connection for the PCW Tag Team Championship on the fed's own "Monday Night Special," 21 September 1998; no result survives.

identity.note: Shares the word "Crush"/"Crusher" with several held entities (crush-ucwf, crush-wicew, crusher-ucwf, the-crusher-napw) — a generic gimmick element independently reused across unrelated feds; no evidence connects this PCW team to any of them.
